What We're Building

Current Projects

Each project solves a real problem for our faculty or students. Practical demand is the only requirement for a project to make the list.

♿
Building

Accessibility Automator

An AI-powered tool that scans course slide decks for WCAG accessibility violations — missing alt text, low contrast, broken reading order — and suggests fixes automatically. Built to solve the real deadline pressure Temple faculty face with accessibility compliance.

Python Canvas API Claude AI WCAG PowerPoint
Learn more → GitHub ↗
💼
Planned

AI Career Coach

A personalized AI career management app for Temple CS seniors — resume analysis, job match scoring, interview prep, and application tracking, all tailored to the current tech job market.

React Python Claude AI Resume Parsing Job APIs
Learn more →
🎯
Building

Owl Jeopardy

An AI-powered Jeopardy-style review game that ingests your Canvas course materials and automatically generates categories and questions — so faculty can run an engaging last-lecture review session without writing a single question by hand.

React Canvas API Claude AI Node.js WebSockets

The Process

One sprint.
One shipped project.

Every 4 weeks is a new sprint, a new project, a new skill unlocked.

01

Ideate

Pick a real problem. AI tools help with research and scoping.

02

Build

Pair with AI — Claude Code, Copilot — to ship fast.

03

Demo

Present to peers and faculty. Get real feedback.

04

Publish

Open-source it. Build your portfolio.

Our Founder

Professor X-Owl

"Mind. Code. Create the Future."

Little is known about the enigmatic Professor X-Owl — and that is precisely how he prefers it. Rumor has it he possesses rare telegraphic abilities, capable of sensing a student's hidden potential before they've written a single line of code.

Before founding OpenOwls, he is said to have run a secretive school for gifted individuals — students with extraordinary abilities who needed only the right mentor to unlock them. The school's motto: "Every owl has a superpower waiting to be unleashed."

Some in the cryptography world whisper that Professor X-Owl may also be the mysterious Hootoshi Nakaowlto — the pseudonymous mind behind a certain revolutionary decentralized ledger that changed the world's relationship with trust and money. He has neither confirmed nor denied this. He simply adjusts his glasses, taps his temple, and smiles.

Today, Professor X-Owl leads OpenOwls with one mission: to find the next generation of AI-powered engineers at Temple University and give them the tools, the projects, and the community to build things that matter.

"I don't teach students to write code. I teach them to think like builders — and then I get out of their way." — Professor X-Owl
